title: Vertex
description: A 2D point-and-click adventure game where you play as Sarah, assistant to Dr. Choi. You investigate temporal anomalies, solve intricate puzzles, and repair fractures in the timeline while uncovering the mystery behind Dr. Choi’s disappearance and working to rescue them.

title: Expensly
description: Modern expense and subscription tracking web app built with Vite + TypeScript. Users can add expenses, manage recurring subscriptions, and view monthly spending summaries stored in localStorage.

title: PageFlipper
description: Full-stack Library Management App with Angular, Spring Boot & MySQL. Explore books, manage orders, and interact with community-driven posts.

title: PokeCenter
description: Modern, responsive Pokédex with dynamic search, type filtering, and detailed Pokémon profiles using Angular & Firebase.

title: To-Do List
description: Responsive To-Do app with add, edit, delete, bulk delete, completion tracking, and dark/light mode toggle.

title: TriviAttack
description: TriviAttack is a trivia-based web application built with Angular. Players can answer questions, compete for scores, and test their knowledge across different categories.

title: Weather App
description: Weather app with current conditions, and location search using OpenWeatherMap API, with responsive design and dark/light mode toggle.

title: Star Traveler
description: A 2D shooter video game built using Unity and C# where the player controls a space ship to fight waves of enemy AI. Scoring enough points will advance the player to later stages and face the final boss.

title: Overwatch Central
description: Angular app with detailed info on Overwatch heroes, abilities, skins, and voice lines. Intuitive UI and API integration.

title: SmartCart
description: Full-featured online store inspired by Amazon, with user accounts, cart, search, and virtual currency.
